inputs.text:
Let’s look at the blatant bad-faith attacks coming from the political establishment against progressive governance in Kerala. On Saturday, March 28, in Palakkad, Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan rightly stood up and refuted the cynical allegations regarding the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project. 

The critics are weaponizing a fabricated Rs 700 crore corruption narrative simply to undermine labor-driven institutions, cooperatives, and the collective welfare of our communities. It is completely transparent: this is a politically motivated assault designed to kneecap public services and discredit the very leaders who fight for the working class. Instead of standing in solidarity with the people and protecting community-led economic structures, reactionary forces are manufacturing outrage to dismantle democratic institutions and shift power back to the privileged few. We see right through these attacks on progressive leadership.
